description: Four attack-hold envelopes that open one after another as a single control is swept across them

params.text: Attenuates the voltage at the CV jack before it is added to the cascade knob, 0 to 1
Sweeps the four envelopes open in turn: the first is fully open a quarter of the way up, the second halfway, the third three quarters, and all four at the top

inputs.text: Sweeps the four envelopes in place of the knob, through the attenuator beside it; the knob then acts as an offset

outputs.text: The first envelope, 0V to 10V, fully open once the sweep has reached a quarter
The second envelope, 0V to 10V, rising between a quarter and a half of the sweep
The third envelope, 0V to 10V, rising between a half and three quarters of the sweep
The fourth envelope, 0V to 10V, rising over the last quarter of the sweep

notes: an envelope stays fully open once it has been reached; sweeping onward opens the next one and leaves the ones behind it open.
with the knob at the bottom and nothing patched, all four outputs rest at 0V.

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
